Benefit Category
Diagnostic Tests (other). Note that a determination that an item or service falls
within a benefit category is not a determination that the item or service is
covered under any particular circumstance.

Item/Service Description
Computed tomography is a diagnostic imaging modality producing cross-sectional
images from multiple radiographic projections. This determination addresses
computed tomography of the head and of the central nervous system when performed
for diagnostic purposes in the outpatient setting.

Indications and Limitations of Coverage
Computed tomography of the head is covered when the ordering practitioner has
documented a clinical indication for which the study is expected to alter patient
management. Coverage requires all of the following.

The medical record documents a focal neurological deficit, an acute change in
mental status, or head trauma with a documented loss of consciousness.

A clinical evaluation has been performed and documented by the ordering
practitioner within thirty days preceding the study.

The study is not a repeat of an equivalent examination performed within the
preceding ninety days, unless the record documents a clinically significant
interval change.

Computed tomography is not covered when performed solely for screening in an
asymptomatic individual, when performed at the request of the beneficiary without
a documented clinical indication, or when an equivalent study performed within the
preceding ninety days is available and no interval change is documented.

Cross Reference
See the applicable local coverage determination for advanced imaging of the
musculoskeletal system.
